# Pulse 1.0.395 🚀

## 🎵 Music player
- 🔎 A lyrics search result for a song on the phone starts that song in the player and opens its lyrics.

## 🏠 Home screen icons
- 🎨 Every extra app and Pulse have real icons in the line look and six Material glass colours; the icon chooser applies the choice to the home screen.

## 🎮 Game Hub
- 🎲 Choosing a box style or ending a cover search refreshes the shelf at once.
- 💿 Hold the open box to eject the disc; drag it onto the console to start the game. The console is drawn for the box's console.
- 🏷️ A console box's spine shows the console's mark instead of its name.
- ⬛ Back from a game: the screen dimmer is cleared and the view is drawn again.
